queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'ActivityWatch' AND publisher = 'ActivityWatch Contributors';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'ActivityWatch' AND publisher = 'ActivityWatch Contributors' AND version_compare(version, '0.14.2') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = 'aw-qt.exe');
